summary: C9: simplify model-picker UX — provider names, no metrics, hidden dollar mechanism
description:
Self-review of PR #40 surfaced that the picker UI exposes
implementation detail that's wrong for an esoteric-literature
audience: model id strings, per-query dollar amounts, token
counts. The infra (USD cap, slug→id resolution, sync timer) is
correct; the surfacing is wrong.

Reframing decisions (operator-confirmed):
  - Picker stays. Voice/personality reframe deferred to a future
    spec; today's job is just to translate the USD-cap mechanism
    into 'questions per day' and hide the rest.
  - Provider names only — DeepSeek, X.AI, Anthropic, OpenAI.
  - Each non-default option shows '~N questions per day' so users
    see the tradeoff. Numbers are typical-case approximations
    derived from the \$0.17/day cap ÷ per-query cost at our 10k-in
    /1k-out workload assumption (DeepSeek ~30, X.AI ~10, Anthropic
    ~4, OpenAI ~4).
  - Per-response attribution becomes a tiny 'via <Provider>' badge
    in a provider-specific token color. No version, no tokens, no
    cost.
  - Quota header shows 'X today' (no hard ceiling). When cap binds,
    unified 429 message regardless of which axis triggered.
  - Client-facing /api/quota response drops usd_used/usd_limit.
    Admin endpoints keep them.

Files:
  - src/lib/provider-display.ts (new) — slug → { name, color }
    map + providerFromModelId(modelId) helper. Reverse-mapping from
    model id is robust against version bumps (anthropic/X stays
    'anthropic' even when X changes).
  - src/app/(app)/settings/page.tsx — replace PICKER_OPTIONS rows;
    drop model-id and price-hint columns; show 'Default · ~30
    questions per day' style label.
  - src/components/chat-view.tsx — replace metric line with 'via
    Anthropic' badge in provider-specific muted color. Banner copy
    updated to operator-approved phrasing.
  - src/app/api/quota/route.ts — strip usd_used, usd_limit from
    response (kept on admin endpoints).
  - src/app/api/query/route.ts — unified 'Daily question limit
    reached' message regardless of reason. The reason field stays
    on the response for logs/admin telemetry but the user-facing
    string doesn't branch.
  - tests updated to match.

Done when:
  - Settings picker shows 4 rows, provider name + per-day quota
    only. No model id strings, no '\$' anywhere user-facing.
  - Chat responses carry 'via <Provider>' badge in correct
    provider color. Tokens + cost not visible to users.
  - Cap 429s show unified message.
  - /api/quota client response has no USD fields.
  - npm run lint + tsc + tests + build clean.

Out of scope:
  - Voice/personality reframe (future BRD).
  - Dynamic per-model effective ceiling in quota header (just
    show 'X today').
  - Real-time price hints in picker (numbers stay static, sourced
    from BRD §3 — bit-rot accepted, daily timer + telemetry
    catches drift).

Spec ref: PR #40 self-review thread.
